items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Horace Henderson in his oral history interview said that Benny used to call Fletcher... Did you know about any of that, or did that happen to you? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: She lived on 138th Street and Lenox Avenue somewhere. Don't go there alone now, especially if you're white. But in those days they didn't do anything.
Horace Henderson in his oral history interview said that Benny used to call Fletcher in the middle of the night and tell him, will you please do such and such a chart, I need it for a recording
session the next day, or something like that. Did you know about any of that, or did that happen to you?

items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Sauter Sotter was in that band.

ctx.x: Eddie Sauter Sotter was in that band. Man, that little guy could write like mad, and in the beginning he didn't write anything, but as time went on, man, he's -- you know the story (unintelligible) on it now. And he's a wonderful guy, and I haven't seen him in years, but these are the type of musicians that Charlie had surrounded himself with.
Did you write originals for him or --
